C9000235.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 235 (Limiting random SAT thresholds, sharp variance and computability.; papers: A Limiting Satisfiability Threshold for Every Fixed Clause Size; Linear Variance of the Random 3-SAT Hitting Time; Variance of the Random k-SAT Hitting Time; Computing the Random 3-SAT Threshold; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/235.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C_RECORD_BRIDGE.statement: Verify ct:old-records and ct:new-record in their actual represented-hierarchy setting, with the original almost-every-complete-global-path quantifier and tolerance.

C_OLD_RECORD_TRANSFER.statement: Old individual and weighted joint records survive absolutely continuous fresh-site-preserving posteriors, decorated-array weak limits, countable partition-selected reindexing, and product-tree representation without increasing tolerance.

C_NEW_RECORD_TRANSFER.statement: A scalar averaged-overlap band of width gamma yields one ancestor probability type with each squared-L2 test error at most 2 J gamma, so gamma <= delta^2/(2J) gives exactly ctr:record and the advertised exponent band.

C_SCALAR_JOINT.statement: Synchronization-free strengthening: the sum of all J squared-L2 test errors is at most 2 J gamma pathwise; only the scalar averaged Gram overlap is needed, and the finite-test Wasserstein budget gamma <= e_0^2/(8J) suffices for newly created blocks.

C_SUPPORT_CORE.statement: An independent-pair closed inner-product constraint extends to all support pairs in an arbitrary separable real Hilbert space, giving the exact norm bound and squared support/barycenter radius 2 epsilon.

C_WEAK_EMPIRICAL.statement: Closed finite-column empirical-product estimates pass through weak convergence; a dyadic countable probability-one event survives arbitrary measurable selection of the countably many path tuples.

C_MARKED_SELECTION.statement: Scalar decoration-tested cut predictions imply the conditional decoration kernel depends only on the tuple's internal cut pattern, validating partition-selected hierarchical reindexing and the Austin-Panchenko representation hypotheses.

C_SOURCE_FACTS.statement: Literature assumptions distinguish prior threshold existence, product-tree representation, pure-state exchangeability, and the restricted finite-RSB elimination result; none alone settles this bridge.

C_MAIN_COMPUTABLE_3.statement: The strict-side proper random 3-SAT threshold exists and is computed to precision 2^(-r) by one total oracle-free deterministic Turing machine.

C_RATIONAL_COMPLETENESS.statement: For every positive a and finite positive beta, P(a,beta) equals the infimum of G_1 over effectively enumerable finite strict rational site-only trials.

C_KERNEL_COLLAPSE.statement: The explicit cc:collapse-error bound removes nonroot globals after finite stopping by using the recorded conditional kernels, exponent sensitivity, count tails, and a small first exponent.
C_KERNEL_COLLAPSE.source: Computing build/sections/closure.tex, cc:site-law, cc:terminal, cc:kernel-collapse; sensitivity.tex, cs:sensitivity

C_STRUCTURAL_TRANSITION.statement: For every fixed output horizon k, ct:transition gives a value-preserving trial with at most two inserted levels, all records, and root termination or first-exponent decrease.
C_STRUCTURAL_TRANSITION.source: Computing build/sections/transition.tex, ct:gaussian, ct:gram-bridge, ct:marked-cuts, ct:endpoint, ct:transition

C_MAIN_FIXED_K.statement: Every fixed k >= 3 has a positive finite limiting proper-clause satisfiability density, with strict-side probability limits.
C_MAIN_FIXED_K.source: Official fixed-clause manuscript introduction.tex, thm:main; the staged directory had only a README

C_FIXED_K_CONCENTRATION.statement: The capped last-satisfiable index has variance O_k(n^(1+2/k)) and the stated polynomial sublinear concentration bound.
C_FIXED_K_CONCENTRATION.source: Fixed-clause concentration.tex, prop:concentration; lem:variance-deletion, lem:pivotal, and forcing.tex prop:forcing

C_FIXED_K_CONVERGENCE.statement: Interior means and polynomial sublinear concentration imply strict-side threshold convergence via auxiliary product interpolation, proper-clause transfer, and balanced center comparisons.
C_FIXED_K_CONVERGENCE.source: Fixed-clause convergence.tex, thm:concentration-to-convergence; lem:auxiliary-product, lem:proper-transfer, lem:balanced-comparison

C_MAIN_VARIANCE_K.statement: Var(H_n) is O_k(n log(en)) for k=3 and Theta_k(n) for k>=4, with the stated capped upper bounds and lower bounds for caps above U_k.

C_K_LIFETIME.statement: For every assignment set and d>=1, tau_k(S) q_d(S)^(k/(k-1)) <= C_k d^(k/(k-1)).
C_K_LIFETIME.source: General-k variance introduction roadmap and replacement.tex, prop:lifetime

C_K_OCCUPATION.statement: The conditional occupation inequality min(L,C_k d^beta a^(-beta)), independent root tests, and weighted collision moments give the stated squared deletion-delay bounds.
C_K_OCCUPATION.source: General-k occupation.tex, lem:conditional-occupation, lem:integrated-occupation, prop:conditional-squared-delay, lem:weighted-root-counts

C_MAIN_VARIANCE_3.statement: For proper random 3-SAT, Var(H_n)<=C n for all n>=3 and Var(H_n)>=c n for all sufficiently large n.
C_MAIN_VARIANCE_3.source: Official linear-variance main.tex, thm:main; Wilson Corollary 4 supplies the lower-bound input

C_3_POTENTIAL.statement: With beta=3/2 and P_d=sum_{j<d}q_j, the stated potential drift controls q_d(S)^beta by d^(beta-1)(3 E_C delta P_d+d u^(-3)).

C_3_OCCUPATION.statement: Independent root tests and potential drift bound each averaged squared omission delay by an absolute constant; summation and tail truncation give linear uncapped variance.

C_GAUSSIAN_SELECTION.statement: Compensated Gaussian probing and conditional-law selection produce marked natural arrays with vanishing Ghirlanda-Guerra errors and the desired selected functional bound.

C_SCALAR_ULTRAMETRIC.statement: The scalar averaged Gram array admits the unit-diagonal Gram bridge, is ultrametric, and has two cuts with the prescribed narrow-band support.
C_SCALAR_ULTRAMETRIC.source: Computing transition.tex, ct:gram-bridge, the scalar part of ct:ordering, ct:quantile-band

C_PRODUCT_REP.statement: The cut-indexed decorations have the prefix-local product-tree independent-uniform representation, retaining all global coordinates.
C_PRODUCT_REP.source: Computing transition.tex, ct:marked-cuts and Austin-Panchenko Theorem 2

C_ENDPOINT_PASSAGE.statement: Uniform empirical tree evaluation, RPC logarithmic averaging, and count truncation identify both endpoint limits with the advertised new exponents and value bound.
C_ENDPOINT_PASSAGE.source: Computing transition.tex, ct:empirical and ct:endpoint; trials.tex, ctr:rpc

C_EXPONENT_SENSITIVITY.statement: The nested transform is sup-norm Lipschitz in the ordered exponent vector with depth-independent constant (5/2) C^2 exp(4C).

C_TERMINAL_TRIAL.statement: Repeated structural transitions and a final posterior telescope give a one-packet terminal trial with at most J processed blocks and depth at most 2J+1.
C_TERMINAL_TRIAL.source: Computing closure.tex, cc:terminal; trials.tex, ctr:reservoir and ctr:posterior

C_TRIAL_SOUNDNESS_EVALUATION.statement: Strict site-only trials upper-bound pressure; a fixed rational trial is uniformly computable and its strict negativity is semidecidable.

C_LOWER_COMPUTATION.statement: The proper three-clause threshold has computable rational lower bounds converging to it, with f_n/n-2^67 n^(-1/6) <= alpha.
C_LOWER_COMPUTATION.source: Computing probability.tex, cp:threshold and cp:finite-computation; assembly.tex

C_UPPER_SEARCH.statement: Negative rational trials certify upper densities and exist at every rational density above the threshold; effective enumeration and the lower certificates give a total precision search.
